title: ENVOYS OF SIX NATIONS PRESENT CREDENTIALS TO THE PRESIDENT OF INDIA
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu accepted credentials from the envoys  of  South Sudan, United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Moldova, Germany and Sweden at a ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 24, 2026).
Those who presented their credentials were:
1.   H.E. Mrs. Sitona Abdalla Osman, Ambassador of the Republic of South Sudan
2.   H.E. Mr. Abdulla Saif Ali Slayem Al Nuaimi, Ambassador of the United Arab Emirates
3.   H.E. Mr. Muhammad Saidu Dahiru, High Commissioner of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
4.   H.E. Mrs. Inga Ionesii, Ambassador of the Republic of Moldova
5.   H.E. Dr. Jasper Wieck, Ambassador of the Federal Republic of Germany
6.   H.E. Ms. Petra Menander, Ambassador of Sweden
***
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: President Droupadi Murmu accepted credentials from six new envoys at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 24 August 2026, representing South Sudan, the United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Moldova, Germany and Sweden. The ceremony formally recognizes these diplomats as accredited ambassadors/high commissioners to India.
enrichment.context: Presentation of credentials is a standard diplomatic protocol under which a newly appointed foreign envoy formally begins their diplomatic mission in the host country by submitting documents from their head of state to the host head of state. In India, the President performs this ceremonial function as head of state, though foreign policy execution rests with the Ministry of External Affairs and the Prime Minister's office. Such events are routine and occur periodically as diplomatic postings rotate, and they do not typically signal any policy shift or bilateral development.
